In English and the other languages: the Board and Calendar titles, the Treasury's gold, the Arena, groups and the War room are now translated.

What the game itself reports about you that counts for the guild: your duels with guildmates, who kills you in PvP outside dungeons, the gold you give a treasurer and the bosses you kill together.

Your position on the map, your gear, your other characters, your BattleTag and where you see enemies are never shared unless you agree separately, one thing at a time. If you don't accept, the addon still shows you your guild, but sends nothing.

Raid bosses are recorded even when the game gives only the first name, and the guild ranking now verifies the other guilds' cards.
Privacy: the page now also says what the game reports on its own (duels, PvP deaths, gold to treasurers, bosses) and everything that is asked separately.

A full review of the addon. On Forever the game gives names differently («El», or «El-Peregrino»), so duels were not recorded, Bones and lottery rolls were not read, gold by trade or mail was recorded under another name, and «See their gear» found nobody nearby. Fixed.
Treasury: gold can also be typed as 2g 50s. Self-test: it says how your game writes names.
Dungeons inside a capital belong to its faction; the rest are for everyone (The Deadmines and Shadowfang Keep now show for both factions).

Dungeons and raids are now WoW Forever's: its 9 new dungeons (Hall of Thanes, Ruins of Lordaeron, City of Dalaran, Blackmaw Hold…) and its three raids, The Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia's Lair, with the game's names.
Molten Core, Blackwing Lair, Zul'Gurub, Ahn'Qiraj and Naxxramas are no longer offered: they are not in Forever. An old raid that used them still shows.

It uses less, and everything stays the same: the addon takes almost half the memory (it keeps only your language), and in a big guild each update of the member list costs several times less and leaves almost no garbage.
The minimap dots and the arrow cost nothing while there is nothing to draw.
The game does not let an addon reload the interface by itself.
Type /reload in the chat and press Enter (now or whenever you like).
Administration: changing the language no longer shows «Interface action failed because of an AddOn». The game does not let an addon reload the interface: type /reload.
Armory: every item shows its name and icon (it used to say «Item 6189» with a question mark). On your own gear, the item's window no longer appears twice side by side.

Marks: the crest over names and the ring on your target's portrait no longer touch the game's protected frames in combat, which could bring up «Interface actions failed because of this AddOn» in the AddOns list.
If the game blocks something of the addon, it is kept with where it came from in Administration, «Internal errors», so it can be fixed.
Whoever installs it sees a notice saying how to open it: /bg or the crest by the minimap.

No more «BlazonGuild has recorded an internal error» in fights: in combat the addon asked the game for the guild's message of the day, and the game does not allow it. Now it reads it when the fight is over.
